title: Ghost of Tsushima — Scarlet Wind
subtitle: Let the real wind guide the leaves.
author: UnfoldMyMac
credit: AI-generated fan artwork. Game, logo & official promotional assets © Sucker Punch Productions / Sony Interactive Entertainment. Independent tribute.

metadata.overview: Leaves follow the actual forecast wind direction and strength for your chosen city. A compass points into the wind, with current speed and gusts beside it. Weather directions describe where wind comes from; leaves travel away from that bearing. Choose a city in Settings. Data refreshes every 10 minutes.

sections.title: Guiding wind
sections.body: Leaves follow the actual forecast wind direction and strength for your chosen city. A compass points into the wind, with current speed and gusts beside it. Weather directions describe where wind comes from; leaves travel away from that bearing. Choose a city in Settings. Data refreshes every 10 minutes.

sections.title: Built for your desktop
sections.body: Live readings stay readable with Reduce Motion. The lid dims the scene and the pointer adds subtle depth. Settings changes are saved per wallpaper.

sections.title: Weather & city data
sections.body: Forecasts by Open-Meteo (CC BY 4.0); city names by GeoNames. Cached readings show their update time and expire after two hours. No precise device location is requested.

sections.title: Artwork & attribution
sections.body: AI-generated fan artwork, with the original game logo and official promotional artwork by Sucker Punch Productions / Sony Interactive Entertainment. An independent tribute; not affiliated with or endorsed by the game’s creators.
